summary.en: Iran has escalated its campaign by striking US bases and an industrial facility in Bahrain, igniting a fire, while also launching missiles into the Strait of Hormuz. Houthi forces continue missile attacks, prompting a Saudi-led coalition to intercept three missiles aimed at Riyadh. Iran’s president says the country faces a silent economic war and will ration electricity. The Lebanese President has demanded Israel withdraw and accused Iran of interference. 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
